policy: Canonical numeric units, display suffixes, API floors and permissions for existing AI source adapters. API knowledge does not enable deterministic mapping or certify hardware support. A display label alone never converts a numeric value.

elevationEvidence.fact: API 2.1.0 elevation samples are meters; this established adapter converts them to feet before formatting.

solarScene.read: Position.getInfo().position (passive cache); Weather.getSunrise(location,Time.now()) and getSunset, both nullable; no active GPS, no network

weatherIcon.read: Weather.getCurrentConditions().condition (nullable cached conditions; use the fixed native icon helper)

calories.read: ActivityMonitor.getInfo().calories (total daily calories, not active-only calories)

oxygenSaturation.read: SensorHistory.getOxygenSaturationHistory({:period=>1,:order=>SensorHistory.ORDER_NEWEST_FIRST}).next() guarded; sample.when age0..300s; data percent >0 and <=100

phoneConnected.read: System.getDeviceSettings().phoneConnected boolean -> 1 connected / 0 disconnected; missing is not zero

moveBarLevel.read: ActivityMonitor.getInfo().moveBarLevel, nullable level0..5 (not a percentage or minute count)

precipitationChance.read: GfcWeather.read(false).precipitationChance, cached current conditions percent0..100; observationTime age0..21600s

windBearing.read: GfcWeather.read(false).windBearing, cached weather degrees; North0/East90/South180/West270; not device heading

sunrise.read: Complications.getComplication(new Complications.Id(Complications.COMPLICATION_TYPE_SUNRISE)).value; seconds since local midnight, nullable; validate0..86399; display HH:mm, no active GPS

sunset.read: Complications.getComplication(new Complications.Id(Complications.COMPLICATION_TYPE_SUNSET)).value; seconds since local midnight, nullable; validate0..86399; display HH:mm, no active GPS

moonPhase.read: Managed GfcMoon.read(lowPower): [estimated phase0..1, illuminated fraction0..1]; UTC2000..2037,10-minute cache, no GPS/network; hemisphere is diagram mirror only

moonIllumination.read: GfcMoon.read(lowPower)[1]*100 when non-null; geocentric estimated visible illumination percent; not cycle progress;UTC2000..2037,10-minute active cache,AOD frozen; formatter must always prefix ~ even when decoration is disabled

nativePolicy.extendedMetrics: altitude/stress/recoveryHours/floorsClimbed/intensityMinutes/humidity/uvIndex/windSpeed deterministic numeric metrics; source-slot options remain the separately validated7-source contract
nativePolicy.weather: shared cached conditions refreshed at most every60s in active. Requires observationTime, age0..21600s; unknown/future/stale observation => missing. AOD no read
nativePolicy.altitude: latest recorded elevation meters converted to existing canonical feet; sample age0..300s; refreshed at most60s active
nativePolicy.complications: stress/recovery queried at most60s active; missing module/type/object/value or exception => missing; published value has no universal observation timestamp, do not claim freshness
nativePolicy.intensity: daily activeMinutesDay.total in minutes, not weekly goal or daily /150 progress
nativePolicy.additionalSources: SpO2 latest recorded <=5min not continuous measurement; phoneConnected maps boolean0/1, refresh<=60s active, unknown stays missing; moveBarLevel0..5 from shared current activity snapshot. Weather same managed60s/6h cache. AOD last active snapshot only. No extra sampling or networking.
nativePolicy.solarReadouts: Garmin Complications SUNRISE/SUNSET seconds since local midnight; fixed HH:mm. Cache<=60s active, invalidated at local date/zone change or clock rollback. Missing/polar-day/unavailable stays missing; no location guessing, no Positioning/network permission. Published value has no universal observation timestamp; no freshness guarantee beyond system source.
